text: Struggling true-crime writer Ellison Oswalt [moves his family into a Pennsylvania house|trigger|making a new home] where the previous family was hanged, and does not tell his wife. In the attic he finds a projector and a box of Super 8 reels labelled as home movies, each one [filming a different family's murder|images|pictures, screens and recordings]. As he watches night after night, chasing his next book, a pale figure surfaces in the footage and in his children's drawings, and an occult professor connects it to [a Babylonian god who devours children's souls|threat|the devil and dark gods].
